Candidates with Reject and Upgrade status if they are not allotted any seat in Round3 (i.e., candidates not holding any seat) the system will consider them as Reject & Upgrade and they will go to Round 4.
In case the candidate does not wish to go to Round 4, such candidates can click on the ‘EXIT’ button to exit the counselling process.

Candidates with Reject & Upgrade status, who do not take decision of EXIT and continue to participate in Round4 will have to mandatorily accept & freeze if allotted a seat in Round 4 and join the allotted college.
There is no seat cancellation option in Round 4 and Fee paid will not be refunded
If Reject & Upgrade status candidate is not allotted any seat in Round 4, then they will be out of COMEDK counselling and fee paid will be refunded.

Not Allotted any seat in any previous round: If you were not allotted any seat in Round 1, Round 2 or Round 3 and get allotted for the first time in Round 4 you will get the option of "Accept & Freeze" and "Reject & Withdraw".
Reject & Upgrade status: If you are NOT allotted a seat in Round 4 you will be out of COMEDK Counselling and will get refund of total fee paid

Accept & Upgrade and Reject & Upgrade status: If allotted a seat in ROUND 4 you will have to join the allotted college. If a candidate fails to join/report and continue the study in the allotted college, he/she will not only forfeit the entire tuition fee including other fees paid at COMEDK level but also be liable to pay a penalty of five times the fee
